_about: Public-domain Caleb Davis Bradlee (1831-1897), Unitarian minister of the Harrison Square Church, Dorchester, and later pastor pro tem. of Christ's Church, Longwood, for the Word Hoard: Sermons for All Sects, Sermons for the Church, his occasional sermons (Christ All in All, Farewell, Death and the Resurrection, The Grand Hereafter, Psalm XXXVII 23), his memoir of Thomas Starr King, his anniversary and ordination histories, Recollections of a Ministry of Forty Years, and A Few Poems. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 111 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
